title: OF THE NIGHT // GEROLD DAYNE CORNERED
narrative: High in the Red Mountains, Areo Hotah and Balon Swann corner Gerold Dayne at High Hermitage. 'Men call me Darkstar,' Dayne sneers, unsheathing a blade of pale milky stone that captures the starlight. Dawn hums in his hand, sharp enough to slice through armor like silk. 'And I am of the night!'
resolvesPlotHole: The Hunt for Darkstar in TWOW

options.text: Claim Dawn as the true ancestral blade of the First Men.
Return the sword to the Water Gardens for Doran's secret masterplan.
